annotations.title: Move a licensed occupation to another province

description: For a licensed occupation (e.g. registered nurse, practical nurse, electrician, teacher) moving to another province or territory: whether the licence is recognized, the regulator, steps, published fees, timeline, added requirements and posted CFTA exceptions, each tied to the regulator's own page, with the checked date and the regmap.ca URL to cite. Omit `to` for every destination at a glance; omit `occupation` to list what is covered.

from.description: Province or territory the person is licensed in now (filters origin-specific notes and exceptions).

occupation.description: Occupation in plain words or its slug, e.g. 'registered nurse', 'LPN', 'electrician'.
